planName: Harness-owned instructions under shared Workcell contracts
summary:
GOAL: replace shared prompt bodies with four generated, self-contained harness families. Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity (agy), and Grok Build retain identical machine-readable contracts for every skill and agent (name, /workcell:<skill> invocation, specifier seal -> builder -> reviewer -> integrator gates, anvil.agent-handoff/v1, and acceptance oracle), while each harness owns procedure prose, prompting style, native feature use, agents, skills, and runtime scripts/hooks. Shared Workcell scripts, tools, resources, and non-prompt code remain shared.

GROUND TRUTH: scripts/sync-agents.py expands agents/bodies/*.md into four mostly byte-identical agent families using variables and only-blocks; skills/<name>/SKILL.md is one body copied verbatim by every stager. agents/models.json routes ten roles and records missing per-agent surfaces. evals/run_evals.py supports only Claude and Codex behavioral executors. The merged plan08 build-{claude,codex,agy,grok}-plugin.py stagers already create symlink-free dist/<harness> trees, but read shared skills and current generated agents. ADR 0023 remains the deployment authority. PR #146 adds only plan08 artifacts and is ignored.

VERIFIED SOURCES (2026-09-01/02): OpenAI GPT-5.6 at https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model?model=gpt-5.6; Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5, and Sonnet 5 under https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/; Gemini 3.7 Flash and prompt strategies at https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/latest-model and https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/prompting-strategies; Antigravity Teamwork/subagents at https://www.antigravity.google/docs/teamwork/ and https://antigravity.google/docs/subagents; Grok Build overview, skills, workflows, settings, and headless guidance under https://docs.x.ai/build/, matching the vendored ~/.grok/docs/user-guide/.

DESIGN TWICE: Candidate A keeps contracts and four bodies artifact-local under skills/<name> and agents/<name>. It has artifact locality but scatters one harness setup and repeats assembly across stagers. Candidate B, selected, creates one deep generation seam: shared contracts/manifests and shared resources feed sync-agents.py plus sync-skills.py; harness sources and tracked generated inputs live under harnesses/<h>/{agents,skills,runtime}; stagers consume only that harness root. Its interface is contract + resolved guide/roster + harness body -> generated setup, deletion would smear validation/parity/omission logic across four stagers, and locality matches the requested four-box architecture plus safe ownership seams. A marked legacy fallback is allowed only during migration; the final gate rejects it.

EXECUTION NOTES (binding): every specifier, builder, reviewer, and integrator runs headlessly. Execution: headless Antigravity (`agy`), model `gemini-3.7-flash`, effort high, via the use-other-harness skill; issues within a wave run in parallel, one workspace each. Each issue is sized for one run well under one hour. Sealed tests and shared contracts cannot be weakened.

ASSUMPTIONS: extracts are concise attributed summaries, not vendor-page copies; freshness compares normalized article content, not navigation chrome; live freshness is a loud gate while unit tests use local fixtures; unsupported optional features are omitted with generated notes, missing required values fail; paid/interactive native features never replace the headless compatibility path.

architecture.changeSummary: One shared skill body and one mostly shared agent body currently flow through four stagers. The target separates immutable contracts and shared resources from harness-owned bodies/runtime, generates a complete tracked input tree per harness, and makes guide freshness, sync drift, contract parity, four-harness evals, and standalone staging independent gates.

issues.title: Build the model-guide extract and freshness gate
issues.body: Create a vendor-neutral checker under docs/models/check. Define prompting.md provenance fields (model, official source URLs, fetched date, extractor version, normalized source digests), selected-content format, --check, --model, deterministic fixture injection, and intentional update mode. Refetch article content, distinguish network/extraction failure from drift, name model and URL, and never rewrite under --check. Vendor selectors are adapters behind one scanner. Execution: headless Antigravity (`agy`), model `gemini-3.7-flash`, effort high, via the use-other-harness skill; issues within a wave run in parallel, one workspace each.

acceptanceTests.name: headless-adapter-is-current-and-bounded
acceptanceTests.oracle: Automation invokes grok --no-auto-update -p with workspace/machine output/timeout and explicit grok-4.6 model strategy.

acceptanceTests.name: unsupported-fields-are-not-invented
acceptanceTests.oracle: No per-agent tool list or unsupported effort appears; optional omissions are noted once and missing required values fail.

issues.title: Record the layered architecture and update Workcell docs
issues.body: Add ADR 0024, superseding only ADR 0005's shared-body implication while preserving wrapper history and ADR 0023 deployment. Record contract fields, four owned families, model guides/freshness, required-vs-optional behavior, Claude-first rollout, measured Fable decision, grok-4.6 pin decision, eval/parity/standalone DoD. Amend ADR 0005 Status only. Update README diagram/layout, install, eval, gates and contributor commands. Show Workcell root feeding four Agents/Skills/Scripts boxes beside shared Workcell Scripts/Tools/everything else. Reject all fallback markers. Broad issue runs alone. Execution: headless Antigravity (`agy`), model `gemini-3.7-flash`, effort high, via the use-other-harness skill; issues within a wave run in parallel, one workspace each.

acceptanceTests.name: adr-0024-records-the-decision
acceptanceTests.oracle: Exactly one ADR 0024 has required headings and records ADR 0005/0023, contracts, four families, guides, omission rule, evals, standalone dist, and final roster choices.

acceptanceTests.name: adr-0005-points-forward-without-rewrite
acceptanceTests.oracle: ADR 0005 Status names 0024 while its historical Context/Decision/Consequences remain; ADR 0023 remains deployment authority.

acceptanceTests.name: readme-diagram-matches-request
acceptanceTests.oracle: Diagram source/rendered SVGs show one root, four harness boxes each with Agents/Skills/Scripts, and shared Scripts/Tools/everything else, with equivalent nearby text.

acceptanceTests.name: docs-publish-all-gates
acceptanceTests.oracle: Docs name agent/skill sync, freshness, parity, four eval commands and four stagers, and mark generated outputs non-editable.

acceptanceTests.name: no-fallback-survives
acceptanceTests.oracle: No legacy-shared-body marker exists and every 16-skill/10-agent source exists in four harness roots; deletion or marker fails naming artifact.

acceptanceTests.name: milestone-definition-of-done-is-green
acceptanceTests.oracle: Freshness, both sync checks, parity, four run_evals --harness commands, and four stagers exit 0; every dist has real Agents/Skills/Runtime and no symlink.

risks.title: Vendor presentation changes cause noisy freshness failures
risks.mitigation: Normalize article content through vendor adapters, fixture-test selectors, distinguish fetch failure from drift, and require intentional named updates.

risks.title: Shared contracts become a second prose body
risks.mitigation: Limit schema to compatibility facts/oracles, reject procedure prose fields, and test independent harness ownership.

risks.title: Migration fallback survives
risks.mitigation: Mark fallbacks mechanically and require the final 16-by-10-by-4 source matrix with no markers.

risks.title: Native interactive features break headless execution
risks.mitigation: Capability-gate forks/Workflow/Teamwork/Grok workflows, retain native headless adapters, and test omission notes.

risks.title: Four families increase semantic drift
risks.mitigation: Parse immutable fields, run parity/routing on all harnesses, and drift-check outputs while allowing prose differences.

risks.title: Grok inherit cannot resolve one guide
risks.mitigation: Mitigated by pinning Grok routes to grok-4.6 in agents/models.json; unresolved required guide values fail generation.

risks.title: Broad seam issues collide with other work
risks.mitigation: Run foundation and final docs alone; all other same-wave hints are literal disjoint roots; ignore plan-only PR #146.
